steps.text: 11:37 P.M. \ Cloudy
Lungmen, Sunset Boulevard, a certain bar, the last unwiped table near the back

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Jack of Spades. Straight flush. I win again, Gambino.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You win again. But you deal slower than I do with my toes.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You backin' out again?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Shut up? Wish you knew how to shut up last night. Coulda saved us a lotta trouble.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You been in Lungmen a long time, Capone. Maybe you need a reminder in how you talk to me, the boss.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Sit down, you moron. It's thanks to that temper of yours that business in Siracusa's so lousy.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You been here seven or eight years, and what've you done besides learn some Lungmen swearings? You stood here and watched our channels dry up?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm the one who got us a supporter last night. Try as you did to cock it up.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: And besides, here in Lungmen, you and me are equals, 'boss.'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: The way this Rat King runs the show here, ain't it just the old worn out Siracusan tricks?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If only you could play a good Siracusan hand worth a damn.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Too bad you're the worst card in it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We got a role to play in Lungmen. Think about it: we got a tired, broken down city with a rich underworld. It could be a new home for the Family.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Only Siracusa can truly respect us, Capone. Don't forget the shame of being driven out of our home with our tails between our legs.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You can't eat honor.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Wei Yenwu set some rules for this city. As long as we don't break 'em, we can run our rackets here just like before. Lungmen needs a little 'legitimate business.'

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...I ain't seen you in years and I'm already gettin' sick of you.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Same same, boss.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You...!
Can you not have your noisy lovers' quarrel in here? This lousy champagne's doin' enough to piss me off. Grab a bottle and take it outside, aight?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Get outta here. This don't concern you.
Watch your tone. I'm the boss in here.
We got a one-stop funeral service, if you're interested. 20% off if you both die together.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Hey... ain't this guy...?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...This is what we get since we left Siracusa. Nobody knows you're Sicilian.
Who gives a shit who you are?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Yo, Capone, do me a favor and torch this tacky joint. Call it 'urban beautification.' Wei Yenwu'll thank us for tearin' down a tastelessly decorated rathole.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Quiet! Don't provoke him!
Oh?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Who you callin' 'tasteless?'
